independence: Round 2: each role filled by fresh claude-opus-5-5 sessions that sat on no earlier jury and drafted nothing (subject x3, safety x2, language x2), each given only its own role's work orders and barred from every other role's orders, verdicts and the earlier round; verdicts combined only by jury run after all seven finished. The redrafts were written by separate claude-fable-5 sessions that sat on no jury.

notes: subject: teach.text states as absolutes 'Benda bergerak kalau didorong atau ditarik' and 'Benda yang diam mulai bergerak kalau diberi dorongan atau tarikan'. This is false in general (pushing a wall or a heavy cupboard does not move it), and the cited NGSS PS2.A says a push or pull CAN start or change motion. Reword with 'bisa' / 'can' (e.g. 'Dorongan atau tarikan bisa membuat benda yang diam mulai bergerak') so the child is not taught that every push moves an object.

claims.claim: Pushing or pulling an object can start, stop or change its motion, and a bigger push makes things speed up more quickly.

sources.title: NGSS K-PS2-1 Motion and Stability: Forces and Interactions
